snapshots.note: v1: batch-1 labels as examples; generic payment=card payment, generic deposit=cash/cheque, generic unknown charge=direct debit, withdrawing abroad=wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal
v2: batch-2 labels as examples; card_not_working vs declined, request_refund timing, compromised vs specific unrecognised txn, transfer fee, source of funds
v3: batch-3 labels; compromised covers stolen details+purchase, spare card = another card, country_support for non-UK card eligibility, declined_transfer when transfers denied
v4b: batch-4 labels; failed_transfer for errors/repeated failures, declined_transfer for 'not possible', PIN acquisition = get_physical_card, SWIFT = top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge

v5 final: batch-5 labels; generic incorrect rate = card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate, foreign ATM rate = wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal, ways to add money = transfer_into_account; 50/50 on bought labels
